items.source: NOTE: This class is intended for internal use by Spring's scheduler implementations. It is only public so that it may be accessed from impl classes within other packages. It is not intended for general use.
items.translation: 注意：此类专为 Spring 调度器实现内部使用而设计。它之所以公开，仅为了允许其他包中的实现类访问它。该类 不 打算供通用使用。

items.source: Decorate the task for error handling. If the provided ErrorHandler is not null, it will be used. Otherwise, repeating tasks will have errors suppressed by default whereas one-shot tasks will have errors propagated by default since those errors may be expected through the returned Future. In both cases, the errors will be logged.
items.translation: 为任务配置错误处理。如果提供的 ErrorHandler 不为 null，则使用它。否则，重复执行的任务默认会抑制错误，而一次性任务默认会传播错误，因为这些错误可能通过返回的 Future 预期。在这两种情况下，错误都会被记录日志。

items.source: Return the default ErrorHandler implementation based on the boolean value indicating whether the task will be repeating or not.
items.translation: 根据指示任务是否重复的布尔值，返回默认的ErrorHandler实现。

items.source: Return the default ErrorHandler implementation based on the boolean value indicating whether the task will be repeating or not. For repeating tasks it will suppress errors, but for one-time tasks it will propagate. In both cases, the error will be logged.
items.translation: 根据指示布尔值返回默认的ErrorHandler实现，该布尔值表示任务是否将重复执行。对于重复任务，它将抑制错误，但对于一次性任务，它将传播错误。在这两种情况下，都会记录错误。

items.source:
An ErrorHandler strategy that will log the Exception but perform
no further handling. This will suppress the error so that
subsequent executions of the task will not be prevented.
items.translation: 一种 ErrorHandler 策略，它将记录异常但不执行进一步的处理。这将抑制错误，从而防止阻止任务的后续执行。

items.source:
An ErrorHandler strategy that will log at error level and then
re-throw the Exception. Note: this will typically prevent subsequent
execution of a scheduled task.
items.translation: 一种 ErrorHandler 策略，它将记录错误级别日志并随后重新抛出异常。注意：这通常会阻止后续调度任务的执行。

items.source:
An ErrorHandler strategy that will log at error level and then
re-throw the Exception.
items.translation: 一种 ErrorHandler 策略，它将记录错误级别的日志，然后重新抛出该异常。

items.source:
An ErrorHandler strategy that will log the Exception but perform
no further handling.
items.translation: 一种 ErrorHandler 策略，它将记录异常但不再进行其他处理。

items.source: Decorate the task for error handling.
items.translation: 为任务添加错误处理装饰器。
